# DropSpace v0.3.1-beta.1

<!-- update-summary: Add optional local AI lyrics (Beta), a shared lyric cache, expanded-island lyric controls and an opt-in fullscreen override. -->

## Changes

- Add optional **AI lyrics (Beta)**, off by default, with Hy-MT2 1.8B Q8_0 (about 1.9 GB) as the default model and the official Hy-MT2 7B Q8_0 (about 7.98 GB) as an explicit optional selection. Downloading either model requires explicit confirmation; translation then runs locally with available lyrics.
- Translate toward the App language while preserving original lyrics and timings. A matching translation from the lyric provider takes priority over AI.
- Persist original lyrics, provider translations and AI translations in a shared cache: **1 GiB (1024 MiB) by default, adjustable from 100 MiB to 5 GiB**. Models and runtime files are outside this budget; cache cleanup and model removal are separate controls.
- Keep the manual lyric refresh action on the main Music page. The next-line preview and revised lyric layout affect only the expanded island.
- Add an **off-by-default fullscreen-island override**. Exclusive fullscreen games and Windows secure desktop/UAC prompts can still prevent the island from appearing.
- Remove the redundant drag compatibility settings card and its experimental label without changing the existing drag behavior. Source-app support still depends on the Windows drag data it exposes.

## AI Beta limitations

First-generation full-song translation can take several minutes. A limited 48-line CPU evaluation of the 1.8B model took roughly 2.5–2.9 minutes with four inference threads; this observation applies only to that earlier 1.8B test, not to 7B, and does not guarantee latency for other devices or songs. A valid cache hit can avoid repeating the work.

A limited 7B CPU startup attempt was stopped at the memory safety threshold without translation output. That attempt does not establish successful model loading; 7B translation quality, resource use and Windows performance are not yet fully validated.

AI translations can change meaning, lose nuance or omit details. The original lyrics remain available, and successful structural validation does not establish translation accuracy. This Beta intentionally exposes the disclosed latency and quality limitations for testing; it does not claim real-time translation or universal language coverage.

AI is optional and disabled in fresh settings. Downloading a model does not silently enable it. Online lyric lookup has its own opt-in provider controls and sends the selected song's public music metadata; local translation does not make every App feature network-free. See [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/airanluo-dot/DropSpace/blob/main/PRIVACY.md).

## Compatibility and release status

v0.3.0-beta.32 is the immediate upgrade baseline. App identity, local data/settings and Stable/Beta update channels remain unchanged. The Beta channel can receive this prerelease after publication; Stable remains v0.2.1 and the websites' primary downloads remain Stable.

This candidate targets x64 Windows build 20348 or later, including Windows 11. Third-party drag providers, physical mixed-DPI setups and real media players retain platform-specific compatibility limits.

Release preparation is not publication. The exact final commit must complete the requested review, release-blocking bug remediation, Windows tests, WinUI build, installer/portable lifecycle checks, runtime verification and package/artifact gates. Unexecuted physical-device checks remain unverified. The official website/API and existing GPT static showcase must be synchronized and checked after the final App release; no future download is claimed by these notes.

## 中文说明

- 新增默认关闭的 **AI 歌词（Beta）**：默认模型为约 1.9 GB 的 Hy-MT2 1.8B Q8_0，另可明确选择官方 Hy-MT2 7B Q8_0（约 7.98 GB）。两种模型都需明确确认后才会下载；已有歌词可在本地推理。7B 的有限 CPU 启动尝试因达到内存安全阈值而停止，未产生翻译输出，不能据此认定已成功加载；其翻译质量、资源占用与 Windows 性能尚未完成验证。
- 翻译目标跟随 App 语言，保留原文与时间轴，并优先采用歌词提供方已有的匹配语言译文。AI 可能误译或遗漏，首次整曲生成可能需要数分钟。
- 普通歌词、提供方译文与 AI 译文共用持久缓存，默认 **1 GiB（1024 MiB）**，可调范围 **100 MiB–5 GiB**；模型和运行时文件不占此缓存额度。
- 手动刷新歌词仅保留在主窗口“音乐”页；下一句预览和歌词布局调整仅作用于展开态灵动岛。
- 全屏显示覆盖选项默认关闭，不保证能覆盖独占全屏游戏或 Windows 安全桌面/UAC 提示。
- 移除重复的拖放兼容设置卡片及其实验性标签，不改变实际拖放行为，也不承诺兼容所有来源应用。

本候选版本从 v0.3.0-beta.32 升级并保留现有数据与设置。完成最终代码审查、阻断问题修复和 Windows 构建打包验证后才能发布；官网与 GPT 静态网站需随最终 App 协调更新并验证。此文件本身不表示版本已公开发布。
